changelog.title: Your opponent picks its own moves again

sections.title: What's fixed
items: The opponent's instructions described one reply and the board read another, so a quick model's move could be swapped for a random legal one with "it answered off-script". Both now ask for the same reply.
The board also takes a move sent in the shorter form a quick model used before this fix, so a move it meant is played, not replaced.

sections.title: What's new
items: Chess now carries its wiki in your copy: vision, requirements, plan, lessons, and next tasks — yours to read and rewrite.
The build prompt that recreates the app ships alongside, labeled as a retrospective reconstruction.

sections.title: What's new
items: Play a full chess game against an opponent with opinions — commentary included.
Runs entirely offline in your file: no server, no account.
